question: 当触摸过保罗的手帕和围裙被带到病人那里时发生了什么？

options.B: 疾病和邪灵离开了病人
options.C: 犹太驱魔师给病人驱魔
options.E: 根据这段文字无法判断

expected_answer: 疾病和邪灵离开了病人
passage:
11 神借着保罗的手行了非凡的奇迹，  
12 甚至连摸过他的手帕和围裙都被带到病人那里，疾病和邪灵就离开了他们。  
13 当时有几个流动的犹太驱魔师试图用主耶稣的名给那些被邪灵附着的人驱魔。他们说：“我奉保罗所传的耶稣的名，吩咐你们。”  
14 这事是犹太大祭司士基瓦的七个儿子做的。  
15 有一天，邪灵回答说：“耶稣我认识，保罗我也知道，你们是谁？”  
16 那附着邪灵的人跳到他们身上，制服了他们所有人。攻击如此猛烈，以致他们赤身裸体、受伤逃出房子。  
17 这事传遍了住在以弗所的犹太人和希腊人，众人都害怕。于是主耶稣的名被尊为至高。  
18 许多信了的人都出来，承认并公开他们的行为。  
19 那些行邪术的人拿出他们的书，在众人面前烧掉。书的价值合计五万德拉克马。  
20 主的话大有能力，继续兴旺起来，得胜前行。

question: Cloths that had touched Paul were taken to the sick. What happened to the sick?
expected_answer: Their diseases and evil spirits left them.
passage:
11 God did extraordinary miracles through Paul, 12 so that even handkerchiefs and aprons that had touched him were taken to the sick, and their illnesses were cured and the evil spirits left them.

13 Some Jews who went around driving out evil spirits tried to invoke the name of the Lord Jesus over those who were demon-possessed. They would say, “In the name of the Jesus whom Paul preaches, I command you to come out.” 14 Seven sons of Sceva, a Jewish chief priest, were doing this. 15 One day the evil spirit answered them, “Jesus I know, and Paul I know about, but who are you?” 16 Then the man who had the evil spirit jumped on them and overpowered them all. He gave them such a beating that they ran out of the house naked and bleeding.

17 When this became known to the Jews and Greeks living in Ephesus, they were all seized with fear, and the name of the Lord Jesus was held in high honor. 18 Many of those who believed now came and openly confessed what they had done. 19 A number who had practiced sorcery brought their scrolls together and burned them publicly. When they calculated the value of the scrolls, the total came to fifty thousand drachmas. 20 In this way the word of the Lord spread widely and grew in power.

question: 谁在路上被狮子咬死了？
passage:
13:23 23 神人吃喝完了，带他回来的年老先知给他备了驴，
13:24 24 他正走的时候，路上遇见一只狮子，杀了他，尸首就躺在路上，驴和狮子都站在尸首旁边。
13:25 25 有人从那里经过，看见尸首躺在路上，狮子站在尸首旁边，就回去告诉年老先知所在的城里。
